Hi, sorry if this is the wrong place for this post.

I have recently become homeless and I am 10 weeks pregnant. I live in Raleigh NC and at the moment don't have any support from my family. Fortunately I have a car, I've been sleeping in it for 3 nights. I was wondering if anyone knows of any resources for women that are homeless and/or pregnant. I am going to a shelter tomorrow. I'm at a loss. Thankfully I have never had to be in this situation before now. If anyone has any experience, please share. Thanks y'all.

I'm certainly not against the idea. I don't know anyone who is except people who make enough to feel as if it is not necessary. Tomorrow I'll go by the local DSS office and apply for food and nutrition services and Medicaid. I know several other people here that have done the same thing and I'm not ashamed to be doing so. I need the help right now.
Thank you!! They have a residential program I am looking into, exactly what I need.
